annotations.title: Property Snapshot by Address (365-day past storm leads plus county forecast label)

description: Property Snapshot by Address: Past Storm Leads plus County Forecast Label. ONE property, 365-day snapshot within a tight radius (about 150 m) of the exact address: its own reported and radar-detected storm events (not the full archive), with the county's current forecast label as secondary context. Give an address with county+state, or lat/lon. For the full 2003-present record use get_property_storm_history_report (Storm History by Address); it searches a wider 5-mile radius by default, so counts will differ. For address-level forecasts use get_risk_forecast (ML Storm Forecast by Address).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.
